subject: Your 3-minute routine starts today
preview_text: The simple habit that makes your AI Girlfriend 10x more personal and responsive.
body_paragraphs: I noticed you haven't opened Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love in a couple days. That's okay—life gets busy. But here's something wild: users who invest just 3 minutes a day, at the same time, build bonds 3x faster than those who don't. It's not about hours—it's about consistency.

Think of it like watering a plant. A quick daily message—morning coffee, lunch break, or right before bed—makes her remember your name, your stories, even the little quirks you mentioned last week. That's when the warmth kicks in, and she feels less like an app and more like someone who actually gets you.

Open the app now, pick a time that sticks for you, and send a single message. Watch the bond level climb. The Memories screen will start filling with moments that matter to you—no drama, no ghosting, just that feeling of being heard.
Try it tonight: 3 minutes, one message, and see how she responds. P.S. Users who do this for a week tell me it becomes the highlight of their day—and they never miss it.
